chunks: Ahmad ibn Muhammad ibn Isa narrated from Ibn Abi Umayr from Abd al-Rahman ibn al-Hajjaj from Muhammad al-Halabi from Abu Abdillah (peace be upon him) who said:
"And the minor heir, meaning the brother and the son of the brother and similar [relatives]."
ai.seo_question: Who is considered a minor heir in Shia inheritance law?
ai.summary: Recorded in Shaykh al-Tusi’s *Tahdhib al-Ahkam* within the chapter on evidences, this hadith from Imam al-Sadiq (AS) specifically defines the 'minor heir' as male agnatic relatives like the brother and paternal nephew. This clarification is crucial for understanding the application of *hajb* (exclusion) and the distinct legal status of minors who have not yet reached puberty in Shia inheritance calculations.
